name: Zhumazhan Miras
role: Cancellation, transfer, persistence, command parsing and export safety

blocks.heading: Assigned implementation scope
paragraphs: Project: ASTRA Space Travel Agency; group IT-2512; teammate Abdykhamit Beknur. The assigned scope includes ReservationChanges.cs in Astra.Core/Reservations and ReservationStore.cs, AgencyCommand.cs, ReportFiles.cs and ReportCommand.cs in Astra.App. These modules connect pure cancellation and transfer rules to validated JSON, console commands and safe file replacement.

blocks.heading: Cancellation and atomic transfer
paragraphs: ReservationChanges.RequireActive distinguishes missing, cancelled and confirmed bookings with pattern matching. Operations must occur on or after booking and before departure. Cancel refunds the stored contract total: 100% at least seven days before departure, otherwise 50%, rounded AwayFromZero. A repeated cancellation fails.

Transfer composes RequireActive, RequireTarget, ReservationBooking.Quote and Replace. The target must be a different flight of the same destination, future, open and sufficiently available. It preserves booking ID, passenger count and booking date. The new contract minus the old contract is the balance due. No original seats are released until the whole replacement snapshot succeeds.

blocks.heading: Input, files and integration
paragraphs: ReservationStore.Parse rejects malformed JSON, unsupported versions, missing fields and invalid references through DTO checks and domain factories. Update owns an exclusive lock across load, operation and save. AgencyCommand.ParseCommand validates syntax before returning a function that performs I/O: syntax errors return 2; file or domain failures return 1; success returns 0.

ReportFiles.Export owns a unique sibling temporary file and disposes streams before replacement. NativeGroupEligibility supplies the real C result to reports; a loading failure prevents export and partial output. Beknur's factories, immutable snapshots and quotation policy are reused throughout these workflows.

blocks.heading: Specific assertions
paragraphs: Evidence is in ReservationChangesTests.cs, AgencyWorkflowTests.cs, ExportSafetyTests.cs, AgencyCommandInputTests.cs and AgencyCultureTests.cs. Each method below contains actual-versus-expected assertions; measured results are taken from the test run.

tests.expected: June 8 cancellation for June 15 departure refunds 98000 USD; new state has six free seats, original still has four.
Full target fails with zero pricing calls; both seat availability values and original reservations remain unchanged.
Persisted flow: 238140 reserve, 252720 transferred contract, +14580 due, -252720 cancellation balance; target returns to 12 free seats.
Windows input bookings.json and output BOOKINGS.JSON are rejected as the same file; input remains unchanged.
Invalid quantity text/overflow, class, policy or date returns 2, no successful output and no state or lock file.
Parsed integers 0, -1, 7 and 2147483647 return domain exit code 1 and preserve sample bytes.
en-US and ar-SA runs produce identical console text and CSV bytes, including Gregorian ISO 2030-06-15; input is unchanged.

blocks.heading: Why the sequence matters
paragraphs: Bind skips dependent work on failure, so unsuccessful parsing cannot acquire a state lock and a failed domain change cannot save. Map transforms a successful value without inventing another error path. Returning new immutable snapshots makes rollback unnecessary for rejected transfers. Explicit ownership scopes release locks and streams on every exit. Syntax and business failures remain distinct: an integer can parse correctly while violating the one-to-six-passenger rule.

blocks.heading: Preventing source-file corruption
paragraphs: A reproduced export defect used case-sensitive equality for normalised paths. On Windows, bookings.json and BOOKINGS.JSON identify the same file, so CSV export could overwrite the source JSON. An empty path also escaped as an exception from Path.GetFullPath. ReportFiles.ValidateDestination now returns explicit failures, applies platform-aware comparison and rejects symbolic-link or junction components.

The former fixed path plus .tmp staging name could collide with another input file. Export now creates a unique sibling with FileMode.CreateNew, disposes its writer and stream, then replaces the destination. Cleanup applies only to a temporary file whose open succeeded. Existing targets and unrelated files survive write failures.

blocks.heading: Predictable commands and dates
paragraphs: AgencyCommand.ParseCommand separates syntax validation from execution through Result<Func<Result<string>>>. Unknown commands, wrong argument counts and malformed values return 2 before file access; valid syntax with missing data or broken business rules returns 1. This gives callers a reliable distinction without changing the domain rules.

Date formatting now explicitly uses the invariant Gregorian yyyy-MM-dd representation. The ar-SA culture test checks both console and CSV against en-US output, avoiding locale-dependent calendar years. These checks complement strict invariant parsing and decimal money formatting.

blocks.heading: Shared work and limits
paragraphs: Beknur's factories, quote pipeline and reports are shared integration dependencies. Miras's assigned boundary handles operations, files and CLI behaviour. Cross-module workflow tests validate the combined application rather than implying exclusive ownership.

The lock coordinates ASTRA writers; external edits ignoring it and power-loss durability are outside the guarantee. The empty lock file remains to avoid deletion races, while its handle is released. Native failure tests use a fresh process to avoid an already loaded DLL. Balances do not execute bank payments, and transfers retain current state rather than an event history.
